name: CXCAS1DT
title: CXCA.S1.DT Determine cervical cancer screening eligibility (FHIRPath re-authoring)
description: FHIRPath re-authoring of the smart-cxca CXCA.S1.DT decision table (CXCAEligibilityLogic CQL library) for kotlin-fhir-workflow, which evaluates text/fhirpath only. Inputs are prefetched by the consumer and bound as collection Bundles: %conditions (the client's Conditions) and %observations (the client's Observations). Eligibility: has cervix (female, minus congenital absence 37687000 and total hysterectomy 428078001) and age within the risk-group range (start 25 if living with HIV per SNOMED 165816005 observation, else 30; upper bound 65).

action.title: Communicate the eligibility determination to the health worker
action.textEquivalent: Determine cervical cancer screening eligibility and communicate the determination

expression.expression: iif((gender = 'female' and %conditions.entry.resource.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and (code = '37687000' or code = '428078001')).exists()).empty()) and iif(%observations.entry.resource.where((status = 'final' or status = 'amended') and code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and code = '165816005').exists()).exists(), birthDate <= today() - 25 years, birthDate <= today() - 30 years) and (birthDate > today() - 66 years), 'Eligible', 'Not eligible')

iif((gender = 'female' and %conditions.entry.resource.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and (code = '37687000' or code = '428078001')).exists()).empty()).not(), 'Client is not in the cervical cancer screening population (no cervix on record); screening is not applicable.', iif(iif(%observations.entry.resource.where((status = 'final' or status = 'amended') and code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and code = '165816005').exists()).exists(), birthDate <= today() - 25 years, birthDate <= today() - 30 years).not(), 'Client has not yet reached the screening start age for their risk group (25 years for women living with HIV, otherwise 30 years); they become eligible at that age. Not yet eligible.', iif((birthDate > today() - 66 years).not(), 'Client is above the recommended screening age range; routine screening is not indicated (assuming adequate prior screening).', 'Client is in the cervical cancer screening target population. Proceed to determine whether screening is due.')))
